page.ui.delivery_ledger_description: The Delivery Ledger is an immutable audit and idempotency log of every message dispatched across Email, Telegram, and WhatsApp. Each delivery records a deterministic idempotency key (campaignSlug + channel + recipient) so retrying a campaign never sends duplicate messages, masks recipient PII (e.g. a***@domain.org, +57***4567), and tracks whether the message was sent live or simulated in Dry-Run mode.
